data_window_note: MMS L2 data ~90 days behind real-time

unusual_events.explanation: Unusually steep magnetic power spectrum: α = -2.554 (much steeper than Kolmogorov α = -5/3 = -1.667). This indicates enhanced dissipation at sub-ion scales, possibly due to Landau damping of kinetic Alfvén waves or reconnection-driven turbulence. Active Langmuir/TSI waves can inject energy into the perpendicular direction, feeding into the turbulent cascade.

electron_holes.note: 8 bipolar E∥ events above 2.95 mV/m — consistent with nonlinear TSI saturation products (electron holes/phase-space vortices)
